descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使饭后自制的纸菜单，画着一大一小两块薄饼，指尖不在配料里。
descriptions.en: A paper menu I made after lunch, with two sizes of injera and no fingertips among the ingredients.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自制的纸菜单，碗边留着一道快要合拢的勺痕。
descriptions.en: My homemade paper menu preserves a spoon’s disappearing trail through shiro.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把拿杖的小插曲折成了一张窄纸片，尖角都朝同一边。
descriptions.en: A narrow paper fold I made after holding the poles, with both points facing one way.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我剪的圆环留了个缺口，专门让眼睛能往外看。
descriptions.en: I cut a gap in this paper circle so there would be somewhere to look through.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己做的双面纸签，两只小手掌朝着不同方向。
descriptions.en: My own two-sided paper tab has a little waving hand facing each way.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 学会并着拿杖后，我在折卡上压出两道朝下的线，没有借用任何展品图样。
descriptions.en: After learning the grip, I pressed two downward lines into my own folded card; no museum design is copied.
